name: Abortion in law, from the statutes cited

measures.definition: On what grounds the law allows a pregnancy to be ended, from 0 (not at all, or only to save the woman's life) to 4 (on request to 10 weeks or later), with the gestational limit in words.

coverage.geography: the 26 countries with a tax model except the UAE; in the United States, the states in the table

rights.attribution: Borgo contributors, from the statutes cited in each figure's note

vetted.notes: Legal facts with their statutes, because the indices on abortion law (Center for Reproductive Rights, WHO Global Abortion Policies Database) may not be redistributed. A neutral fact: whether and which way it counts is the person's own stance.

caveats: Each figure's note says whether the law was checked against the source linked (the statute, or an official page that states it) on 2026-11-05, or is stated from the law cited because that source could not be read (Greece, Canada, Australia, California, New York, Massachusetts, Illinois).
In the United States each state sets the law: a state not in the table has no figure, never a national one.
The law on paper, not access in practice: waiting periods, counselling, cost and the distance to a provider are in the note where the statute sets them, not in the level.
